concepts.name: Supplier quotation
concepts.description: A supplier statement, never a purchase approval or verified payment

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Explicit ISO currency code; INR for ₹, USD for $, EUR for €

fields.name: valid until
fields.description: Unambiguous explicit ISO expiry date; abstain on ambiguous dates

concepts.name: Quotation line
concepts.description: One quoted SKU; distinct source assertions may conflict

fields.name: lead days
fields.description: Explicit exact lead time in days; abstain on ranges or weeks

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Quantity explicitly requested or offered; do not invent missing quantities

fields.name: tax rate
fields.description: Explicit tax percentage as a decimal string, e.g. 18 for 18%; no inferred tax

fields.name: unit price
fields.description: Quoted NET UNIT price, not a line total; no arithmetic inference

fields.name: warranty months
fields.description: Explicit warranty in months; do not convert years
